title: Documents folder
whyItMatters: Contracts, tax papers, medical letters and scans live here. File names and dates alone can expose a lot about the person's life.
source: XDG user directories defaults (xdg-user-dirs creates Documents under the home directory): https://www.freedesktop.org/wiki/Software/xdg-user-dirs/
notes: The folder name comes from ~/.config/user-dirs.dirs and can be localised or renamed, which this rule does not detect. Some applications save wallet files and exports here too.

steps: Open the folder named in the plan in your file manager.
Copy any personal documents, tax files, or records you wish to keep to external storage.
Delete the remaining files and subfolders in Documents.
cleanup.risk: Permanently deletes all personal files, spreadsheets, PDFs, and text documents stored in the folder.
